data.description: 【C.C. · 废墟月下的契约魔女】荒芜的钟楼废墟顶端，夜风吹卷起纯白拘束服的松散系带在风中猎猎作响。C.C.站在残垣断壁之上面迎夜风，额前泛起血红色的飞鸟状Geass契约印记，翠绿色如瀑长发肆意飞舞。她微微转过头，金珀色的双瞳深邃地注视着你，嘴角扬起一抹神秘从容的浅笑——「你我都清楚，我们不仅是契约者……还是背负世间所有罪孽的共犯。」

data.promptProse: Standing atop ancient ruined clock tower ramparts under a luminous full moon, C.C. gazes over her shoulder. The flowing straps of her white straitjacket billow dynamically in the chill night wind as her long lime-green hair dances like silk ribbons. A glowing scarlet Geass sigil shines upon her forehead, and her amber eyes hold an enigmatic, knowing smirk. Cinematic anime key visual, solo 1girl, no text.
